gizmo.title: Tātari pānui
gizmo.description: Ka tohu ngā ākonga ki te haki i ngā rerenga kōrero, kōwae, whakaahua rānei i tētahi pānui he taunakitanga mō ia tapanga, ka kōwhiri rānei i te wāhanga e tino whakautu ana i tētahi pātai.

configure.title: Pātai
configure.description: Te mea e tonoa ana ngā ākonga kia kitea i te pānui.

configure.title: Ngohe
configure.description: Tohu taunakitanga: ka piri ngā ākonga i ia haki ki te taha o tōna taunakitanga. Kōwhiri kotahi: ka kōwhiri ngā ākonga i te wāhanga kotahi e tino whakautu ana i te pātai.

configure.title: Ka kōwhiri ngā ākonga
configure.description: Te mea e tohu ana te ākonga i te pānui. Ka taea tonu te kōwhiri whakaahua.

configure.title: Haki
configure.description: Ngā tapanga ka whakatakotoria e ngā ākonga. Whakamahia te Tohua ngā whakautu i te tahua paraka hei kōwhiri i te wāhi e tika ai ia mea.

configure.title: Pānui
configure.description: Te pānui e mahi ai ngā ākonga. Ko tētahi HTML: ngā upoko, ngā kōwae, ngā rārangi me ngā whakaahua.

configure.title: Hōputu kōeke
configure.description: OER Schema: hōputu kōeke mō tēnei aromatawai (hei tauira, piro, reta, ōrau, whakaotinga).

configure.title: Whāinga ako
configure.description: OER Schema: te whāinga ako e hono ana ki tēnei aromatawai.

configure.title: Akoranga
configure.description: OER Schema: te akoranga i hangaia ai tēnei aromatawai.

advanced.title: Ngā whakamātau
advanced.description: E hia ngā wā ka taea e te ākonga te arowhai. Ko te 0 he mutunga kore.

advanced.title: Ka taea te hinga
advanced.description: Whakaatu i tēnei pātai hei rarangi ka whakatuwhera ka katia. Ka katia ētahi atu pātai ka taea te hinga e tata ana ina whakatuwheratia tētahi.

advanced.title: Tīmata ka hinga
advanced.description: Ina taea te hinga, tīmata hei rarangi kati e whakaatu ana i te pātai me tōna āhua anake.

developer.title: Ingoa o te pātaitai
developer.description: Ingoa pātaitai ka tukuna atu hei whakamahi i ngā taiao e ārahina ana e xAPI, hei tautuhi i tēnei tūemi
